patch_description: Replace the final adaptive bilateral one-pole damper with a fixed-λ Whittaker–Henderson smoother (second-order difference penalty) solved with a banded Cholesky solver in O(n). Evidence: Gen 40 scored 0.71 with the adaptive damper; a constant λ keeps the curvature penalty uniform over the signal (no noise leaking through where α relaxed), and the second-order penalty's flatter passband reduces residual ripple (slope changes, false reversals) without adding phase lag or the attenuation a stronger one-pole would bring. λ is scaled from existing residual MAD: λ = clip(25·(r_std/σ_r)², 1, 200). Applied to the full-length signal and sliced last, preserving the len(y) = n − window_size + 1 contract.
